item.title: RESTful API Design
item.description:
REST Principles

REST uses HTTP methods for CRUD operations.

HTTP Methods

  • GET: Retrieve data
  • POST: Create new resource
  • PUT: Update resource
  • DELETE: Remove resource

item.title: Database Indexing
item.description:
What is an Index?

An index is a data structure that improves query performance.

Types of Indexes

  • B-Tree Index
  • Hash Index
  • Full-Text Index

item.title: Microservices Architecture
item.description:
What are Microservices?

Microservices break applications into small, independent services.

Benefits

  • Independent deployment
  • Technology flexibility
  • Fault isolation
